rubric.role_summary: Founding VP of Regulatory Affairs to build a regulatory function and lead global strategy and submissions for therapeutics and diagnostic biomarkers across neurology, metabolic disease, and ophthalmology.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Founding VP of Regulatory Affairs to build a regulatory function and lead global strategy and submissions for therapeutics and diagnostic biomarkers across neurology, metabolic disease, and ophthalmology.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 10+ years of regulatory affairs experience in biotechnology and/or pharmaceuticals, including direct experience as a regulatory lead and in a leadership role.
- Advanced degree in life sciences, technology, chemistry, or a related discipline.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Exposure to regulatory approvals involving computationally enabled tools or biomarkers, ideally including AI methods.
- Experience taking therapeutics and diagnostic biomarkers from first-in-human through proof-of-concept to NDA/BLA submission in metabolic disease, neurology/neurodegeneration, or oncology.
- Advanced degree in life sciences, technology, chemistry, or a related discipline, with either a specialized degree in regulatory science or equivalent practical experience.
- Demonstrated command of regulations and guidelines governing drug, diagnostic, and device development, including good clinical practice, clinical trial design and execution, clinical pharmacology, biostatistics, and clinical operations.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
